t: You're at the site of Holy Trinity, Minories, which no longer stands. It began as the chapel of a nunnery and served as a parish church from the sixteenth century until the end of the nineteenth. It survived as a parish hall until bombing destroyed it in the Second World War. Several members of the Legge family are buried here. They include George Legge, the naval commander whom James the Second made Admiral of the Fleet, and William Legge, the first Earl of Dartmouth. The long-serving MP Sir Christopher Musgrave is buried here too.
